title: Preserve explicit string-number display requests
scope: Retain the authored ShowStringNumber property independently from string identity.
acceptance: Test true, false/absent and a non-default note string without changing pitch or tuning.
Keep the display request on the exact note across reused definitions.
Independent GP8 consumption retains the authored flag and strict parsing no longer reports this supported property as lost.

reproduction.instructions: Reproduce via the public Go parser and GP8 exporter, then load original and output with pinned AlphaTab. The observed end-to-end difference alone does not locate the failing stage.
